title: Playboy August 2006 Stacey Dash Denis Leary Luke Wilson Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Corner wear at the top right of the front, small chips along the left edge, and a diagonal crease across the top of the back cover. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, August 2006. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Stacey Dash of Clueless in a gold bikini.

Cover features: Clueless star Stacey Dash pictorial; Denis Leary interview; 20Q with Luke Wilson; Real Girls of the O.C.; sun, skin and the birth of the bikini - a sizzling tribute; Why are we in Iraq? John McCain, Lindsey Graham and Jessica Lynch speak out; NFL preview; Milan fashion.

Back cover: Skyy vodka ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
